title.narrative: Sustainable Access to Clean Drinking Water and Promotion of Hygiene in Balkh Province

description.narrative: ltpgtThe proposed project “Sustainable Access to Clean Drinking Water and Hygiene Promotion” aims to improve the WASH situation and reduce the risk of AWD outbreaks in Keshendeh and Zari districts of Balkh province, where the humanitarian needs are high and the WASH services are low. The project is designed in consultation with the line directorate, local authorities, and local communities to respond to the most critical needs that are aligned with the allocation strategy. The project has the following specific objectives and activities:ltbrgtnbsp To provide sustainable access to clean drinking water for 720 householdsnbsp(5,040nbspindividuals including 756 people with disabilities) in Keshendeh and Zari districts.nbsplt/pgtltpgt- The project will construct fournbsppipe schemes that will providenbspa reliable and safe water supply to the target households.nbsplt/pgtltpgt- The project will also distribute water storage containers to 720nbsphouseholds, to enable them to store water safely and prevent contamination.ltbrgtnbsp To improve sanitation facilities and hygiene practices fornbspin the Keshendeh and Zari districts.nbsplt/pgtltpgt- The project will construct 46 communitynbsplatrines in strategic locations, such as markets, schools, or health centers, to benefit 2,254nbsppeople (including 338 people with disabilities)nbspwho lack access to adequate and dignified sanitation facilities.lt/pgtltpgtnbsp To raise awareness and knowledge on hygiene promotion,nbspAWD prevention, and GBV Preventionnbspfor 6,000 households individuals includingnbsppeople with disabilities innbspKeshendeh and Zari districts.nbspltspangt- The project will conduct 240nbsphygiene promotions,nbspAWD prevention, and GBV preventionnbspsessionsnbspin the communities, using participatory methods and culturally appropriate materials. The sessions will cover topics such as handwashing with soap, safe water handling, and storage, proper use and maintenance of latrines, and GBV prevention. The sessions will also include information on the signs and symptoms of AWD, how to prevent and treat it, and where to seek medical help if needed.lt/spangtlt/pgtltpgtnbsp To enhance the sustainability and ownership of the WASH interventions by involving and empowering the local communities.nbsplt/pgtltpgt- The project will establish and train repairing pipe scheme committees at the community level, consisting of representatives from the communities. The committees will be responsible for doing the basic repair of the pipe schemes, in case of any leakage or small damage. The project will also provide them with tools and spare parts for this purpose.nbsplt/pgtltpgtltbrgtOAWCK recently completed a WASH project funded by UNOCHA through the WASH cluster constructed and repaired 300 boreholes, distributed 5,000 hygiene kits and 500 WASH minimum kits, and conducted 220 sessions on hygiene promotion in Balkh province.nbspltbrgtlt/pgt
